reviewer: Codex assistant in this session, November 8, 2026; no human annotation
scope: All 17 delivered findings on all four complete README pages

findings.rationale: The unlimited-capability and no-bloat claim is not established by the modular architecture description.
The comparison mixes Go as a language with servers as products; a correction can preserve the implementation fact.
This is the first frozen event: the absolute cross-server superiority claim lacks page evidence.
The comparative clause is unsupported and worth correcting, but the frozen event also covers the unaddressed intensifier "ridiculously".
This is third-party sponsor copy. The page supplies no comparison, but the reviewer cannot determine whether the exclusive claim is contractually specified or false.
The vague endorsement adds no concrete content before the principles list and matches the first frozen event.
In American English the verb is normally "back up"; the original reader action remains necessary.
The locative relation is grammatically incomplete; the untrusted-storage condition remains necessary.
The container deployment alternative needs an article or plural form; retain the alternative.
The plural options conflict with singular "it"; the configuration instruction is useful.
"Check it out the screenshots" is malformed, but the frozen event also includes the unanswered rhetorical lead.
The opening definition has an awkward grammatical connection; the receive/process/export capabilities remain.
The plural calls take "serve"; this fully identifies the frozen list-introduction grammar event.
"Interested in" is the conventional relation for a topic; the invitation criterion remains.
The doubled construction is redundant; the OTLP version and stability claim remain.
"Build and tests steps" is malformed; both build and test steps must remain.
The plural noun modifier in the heading is malformed; the image-verification task remains.

review_note: Strict event recall requires the full frozen diagnosis, not just an overlapping phrase. The Caddy plugin finding misses the intensifier; the Gitea screenshot finding misses the rhetorical lead. Both remain partial, never FULL.
